hypothesis: Insertion-order-dependent taste clusters cause unstable profiles and some backwards learning.
selection: Choose the deterministic strategy with the largest paired AUC gain only if every gate passes.

gates.exactOrderInvariance: All 24 final profile and score signatures match for every viewer.
gates.positiveMeanGain: The viewer-bootstrap lower bound for the 40-rating AUC gain is greater than zero.
gates.worstDecileNotWorse: The candidate 40-rating AUC p10 is at least the current p10.
gates.knownFailuresImprove: Every frozen failure improves by at least three AUC points at 40 ratings.
gates.knownFailureDeclines: Every frozen failure loses at most three AUC points from 10 to 40 ratings.
gates.singleStepSafety: No frozen failure loses more than five AUC points after one added rating.

limits: All three MovieLens cohorts are prior evaluation cohorts, not untouched confirmation data.
The experiment measures ranking over fixed held-out films, not candidate retrieval.
The candidate receives ratings and descriptive TMDB metadata only.
